issue_creation_policy: Only Codex may create new tickets/issues unless the user explicitly authorizes another model.

issues.title: Prevent old Sui package entry points from bypassing upgraded authority
issues.evidence: Old package versions remain callable and can still write shared state through unchecked old functions.
acceptance: Define authoritative new state that old entry points cannot modify; preserve required migration/history.
Deploy a prior package, create objects, upgrade and demonstrate attempted old-package report/authority bypass is rejected or cannot affect trusted receipts.
Document upgrade, mixed-client support and recovery.
issues.validation: Move tests plus actual old/new package and state migration acceptance tests.

issues.title: Introduce a network deployment manifest with per-type origins
issues.evidence: All dynamic-field types use the initial package ID; newly introduced types actually originate in the upgrade package.
acceptance: Record verified chain identity, latest call ID, per-type origins, shared IDs, protocol version and compatible client ranges.
Generate frontend/device configuration from one manifest and reject stale network/ID combinations.
Cover fresh publish, multiple upgrades and introduction of RecipeDigestKey/DeviceAddressKey in later packages.
issues.validation: Unit/generated-fixture tests and a live multi-upgrade origin resolution test.

issues.title: Migrate the frontend SDK and wallet integration to supported Sui APIs
issues.evidence: Legacy dApp Kit and Sui SDK are temporarily pinned together; the app still depends on retiring JSON-RPC.
acceptance: Migrate SDK, wallet providers/hooks and transaction execution together to supported gRPC/GraphQL clients.
Retain inventory/group/deployment queries, pagination, account/network handling and execution-effect checks.
Remove legacy API calls and document the tested compatible dependency set.
issues.validation: Frozen install, typecheck/build and actual wallet connect/sign/reject/chain-mismatch acceptance.

issues.title: Migrate the daemon reader, transaction builder and executor to supported Sui APIs
issues.evidence: Daemon queries and unsafe_moveCall execution still require deprecated JSON-RPC.
acceptance: Use supported transport and transaction building; verify chain identity and per-type origins.
Preserve durable cursor recovery, filtering, independent signatures and status effects checks.
Define historical/archival retention and handle disconnect/cursor migration without replaying applied work.
issues.validation: Rust tests, actual-daemon simulator adapted to new transport, and real chain success/failure/offline recovery.

issues.title: Generate and verify shared contract, event and recipe interfaces
issues.evidence: Contract signatures/event fields previously changed independently of clients/tests.
acceptance: Provide a generated or centrally defined interface for calls, events, keys, statuses and recipes.
Compare both clients to actual compiled Move interfaces and fail CI on drift.
Declare compatibility/version rules and reject unknown protocols before apply.
issues.validation: Positive and negative schema/interface compatibility tests using compiled contract artifacts.

issues.title: Harden publishing and configuration generation
issues.evidence: Unscoped TOML greps can mix environments; the publish pipeline suppresses errors and only updates frontend config.
acceptance: Parse metadata by environment and verify actual chain identity/account/UpgradeCap.
Stop on failed publish/upgrade/effects/metadata parsing and preserve prior config on failure.
Record release IDs/type origins and generate both client configs atomically.
issues.validation: Offline parser/failure tests, dry run and explicit testnet publish/upgrade acceptance.

issues.title: Add reproducible CI and release compatibility gates
issues.evidence: The repository has no automated checks for the repaired cross-layer flow or upgrade compatibility.
acceptance: Run locked Move/Rust/frontend checks and the real-daemon simulator on pull requests.
Record/pin tested toolchain/dependency versions and retain failure diagnostics without secrets.
Provide separately authorized live upgrade/wallet/hardware gates; do not publish in ordinary PR CI.
issues.validation: Successful CI plus deliberately failing contract drift, execution effect and recovery regressions.

issues.title: Implement revocable device identity and capability lifecycle
issues.evidence: Signer binding exists but there is no complete revocation/rotation/deregistration enforcement.
acceptance: Enforce active identity and revocation at authoritative on-chain reporting/update boundaries.
Define key rotation, reissuance, ownership transfer and legacy-cap migration.
A revoked or deregistered device cannot submit trusted receipts through old or new packages.
issues.validation: Contract adversarial tests, mixed-version upgrade tests and live rotation/revocation acceptance.

issues.title: Constrain updater and component execution privileges
issues.evidence: Recipe commands are opt-in and bounded, but execution lacks per-component privilege/resource isolation.
acceptance: Define least-privilege users, filesystem/resource boundaries and required firmware-only privileged operations.
Preserve authenticated recipes and process-tree cleanup on cancellation/timeout.
Document and test privilege failures without silently reporting Applied.
issues.validation: Negative privilege/timeout tests and service/image validation.

issues.title: Establish live wallet-to-device and package-upgrade acceptance suite
issues.evidence: Local tests do not prove supported public-network operation, per-type origins or security against old entry points.
acceptance: Exercise fresh registration, cap issuance, recipe upload, direct/group deployment and real execution effects.
Cover existing objects, later-introduced types, legacy caps and old-package attacks across upgrades.
Record environment/tool versions, artifacts and recovery; never include keys in logs.
issues.validation: Actual supported testnet/browser/device runs with positive and negative results.
